index.stand: A digital refresh set a new visual direction for Cosmo Prof, the salon supply retailer. | The site had to match the professionals using it, and the new look couldn't slow the store down.
abs: Typography moved to Jost, and the palette put soft neutrals against sharp black.

The frame | cleaner compositions, each one defining what a good Cosmo Prof picture looks like.
One source | every template pulls its pictures from the photo library.
